title: Property & Casualty Insurance Assistant
description:
Description
About Vert Agent
Vert Agent is a growing company that connects businesses with highly skilled remote professionals who provide reliable, specialized support across a variety of industries. We help companies streamline their operations, improve efficiency, and scale their teams by connecting them with talented professionals who bring the right experience and expertise to each role.
At Vert Agent, we value professionalism, accountability, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering high-quality work. We are looking for individuals who are motivated, organized, and ready to contribute to the success of the companies and teams they support.
About the Role
﻿ We are looking for an experienced Property & Casualty Insurance Virtual Assistant to support a growing U.S.-based insurance company with day-to-day administrative and insurance-related tasks.
The ideal candidate has previous experience working remotely within the P&C insurance industry and is already familiar with insurance quoting processes and completing ACORD forms. This role requires someone who is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and able to accurately handle insurance documentation and administrative responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with day-to-day administrative tasks for a growing insurance company.

• Prepare and complete ACORD forms accurately and efficiently.

• Assist with insurance quoting for Property & Casualty policies.

• Gather, organize, and verify client and policy information needed for quotes and insurance documentation.

• Maintain accurate client, policy, and insurance records.

• Support the team with document preparation, data entry, and general administrative tasks.

• Follow up on missing information or documentation as needed.

• Maintain a high level of accuracy and confidentiality when handling client and insurance information.

• Provide additional administrative support as the company continues to grow.

Requirements

• Previous experience working as a Virtual Assistant or administrative professional within the Property & Casualty insurance industry .

• Hands-on experience completing ACORD forms (MUST)

• Experience assisting with or preparing P&C insurance quotes (MUST)

• Familiarity with common Property & Casualty insurance terminology, documentation, and workflows.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills (C1,C2)

• Comfortable learning and working with insurance platforms and other digital tools.

• Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based insurance agency or brokerage .

Compensation & Benefits
﻿$1,200 per month

• 10 days off per year

• 6 U.S Federal Holidays

• 3 sick days

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

THE ROLE

The Accounting Partnerships team helps Airwallex reach ambitious SMEs through the firms and technology providers they already trust: accounting firms, experts-comptables, ERP and accounting-software partners, resellers, integrators and outsourced CFO/advisory firms.

As Accounting Partnerships Manager, France, you will build and grow a partner-led acquisition channel for the French market. You will identify the right partner segments, create trusted relationships, activate partners and turn those relationships into qualified introductions and pipeline for Airwallex.

This is a hands-on commercial role. You will personally source and develop partners, create the partner value proposition, test referral and co-selling motions, enable partners and work closely with Sales to convert partner-sourced opportunities. You will also build the simple operating rhythm needed to scale what works.

The role is focused on lead generation and partner activation, not technical integrations. You do not need to build APIs, but you must be able to understand customer problems, explain Airwallex’s value clearly and work with Product, Sales and Marketing when a partner or customer need requires support.

The role is based in Paris, with a minimum of three days per week working from our office.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and own the French accounting-partner strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

- Define and prioritise the partner ICP across accounting firms, ERP/accounting-software vendors, resellers, integrators and outsourced CFO/advisory firms.

- Build a target list, map decision-makers and source new partners through outbound, warm introductions, events and existing relationships.

- Recruit, qualify and activate partners based on client fit, influence, willingness to recommend and ability to generate opportunities.

- Create simple referral, co-selling, client-introduction and co-marketing motions that produce qualified leads.

- Build partner messaging and enablement materials that explain Airwallex’s value to both the partner and their clients.

- Work with Sales Managers and AEs on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and feedback on partner-sourced opportunities.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer- Hardware

This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage
Comfort working

title: Director of IT & Security, CISO

With just one connection, data can be orchestrated across a growing network of 12,000+ systems and organizations, including 100+ electronic health record systems (EHRs). Redox processes over 1.2 billion messages per month across our health tech vendor, provider, payer, EHR, and life sciences customers.
Opportunity & Impact

Redox is seeking a hands-on Director of IT & Security, CISO to own enterprise security, cloud, and application security, and corporate IT. This role reports directly to the CTO and is a core member of the technology leadership team.
You will lead security engineering, security operations, and corporate IT while partnering closely with Engineering, Platform, and Operations to embed security and reliability into how Redox builds and runs software. Success in this role means strong security posture, resilient internal systems, and an employee experience that just works-without slowing the business down.
Job Responsibilities

•
Security Strategy & Leadership: Own end-to-end information security strategy across cloud, application, infrastructure, and corporate environments. Define a pragmatic security roadmap aligned to business risk, regulatory requirements, and engineering velocity. Serve as the executive owner for security posture, risk management, and incident response. Act as a trusted advisor to the CTO and executive team on security, risk, and operational tradeoffs.

•
Security Engineering & DevSecOps: Drive a DevSecOps-first operating model, embedding security into CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and developer workflows. Manage vendor relationships, including CrowdStrike, Flashpoint, RAD, and Okta.

Drive automation and standardization across onboarding, offboarding, access management, and device lifecycle. Partner with People Ops, Legal, and Finance on IT processes, audits, and vendor management.

•
Compliance, Risk & Healthcare Context: Own healthcare-related security and compliance programs (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2). Translate regulatory requirements into practical, engineering-friendly controls. Lead third-party risk management and vendor security reviews. Support customer security reviews and serve as an executive point of contact on security matters.

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge - navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

 

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

Benefits at Remote is becoming the provider-agnostic, payroll-correct, compliance-monitored infrastructure layer that sits underneath every way Remote employs someone - Employer of Record, global payroll, PEO - and, increasingly, underneath any external HR system a customer brings. It stops being a standalone module people click through and becomes a layer other systems build on top of: invisible when it works, indispensable when it doesn't.

Near term, this is a deeply integration-heavy role. You'll take over a live, high-stakes book of work: migrating benefit costs onto a unified payroll system across multiple carrier and broker paths, standing up retirement plan administration for US global payroll, building provider-agnostic cost ingestion so any customer can bring their own broker or carrier, making benefits data flowing out of clients' own HR systems land correctly in payroll, and resolving benefit-cost data-integrity incidents that touch real employee paychecks. This is hands-in-the-data work: reconciliation logic, eligibility files, settlement thresholds, migration sequencing.

Longer term, this is a full-scope experience and unification role. As Remote consolidates fragmented, product-by-product benefits tooling into one administration platform, one cost-ingestion pipeline, and one source of truth, you'll own the vision and roadmap for making benefits behave consistently everywhere - the same primitives (offers, costs, enrollment, providers, statuses) working the same way across 90+ countries and across Employer of Record, global payroll, PEO, and HRIS-connected customers alike. You'll also own how that layer shows up for non-human consumers - APIs and agent-facing tooling - not just for people in a UI.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role reporting into Product leadership, with regular exposure to Engineering, Payroll Operations, Partnerships, Finance, and Legal/Compliance.

What you bring

• Proven experience as a product manager owning complex third-party integrations (API and file/EDI-based)

• A provider-agnostic mindset: you default to ingesting a customer's existing reality, and anticipating their future needs (their broker, their carrier, their HRIS) rather than forcing them onto a fixed set of embedded partners.

• Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code is required. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code/prototypes, not just write specs.

• Comfort designing for systems as well as humans - you think in APIs and agent-facing tooling, not just dashboards, and can justify a feature by whether it makes a pay run more correct or compliant, not just whether it "feels complete."

• Judgment to make both strategic calls (what to consolidate, what to prioritize, what to explicitly stop doing) and tactical ones (scope of a given integration) under real deadline pressure.

• Excellent async written communication - you'll drive alignment across Engineering, Payroll Operations, Finance, Partnerships, and Legal without relying on meetings.

• Bonus: E

title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Developer

description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior SAP S/4HANA Developer on behalf of our client to lead backend and full-stack development within a modern S/4HANA enterprise landscape. In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications-leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

•
5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

•
Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

•
Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

•
Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

•
Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

•
Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

•
Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

•
Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

•
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

•
Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

•
Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

•
Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability.

•
Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations.

•
Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility.

•
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.

 

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments

title: Engineering Manager, Proactive Security - Platform

You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for building “paved road” Platform Security controls to harden our compute and storage platforms and provide for a safe, secure and resilient delivery network. This is a US or Canada remote position reporting directly to the Director of our Security Engineering team.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Set and execute the technical vision for the Security Engineering Platform team, spanning AWS and GCP account/workload hardening, and vital tier-0 services (Access, Identity, Teleport, HashiCorp Vault, Tokenization and others).

• Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

• Own the hardening roadmap for tier-0 cloud infrastructure and access services, backed by rigorous, follow-the-sun on-call. Success is measured in eliminating classes of misconfiguration and exposure at the platform layer, not in shipping code for its own sake.

• Coach and mentor highly skilled tech leads and engineers as a "player-coach," leaning in at the lowest technical level on cloud hardening, identity, and secrets management problems, and lead the team to build the right durable controls.

• Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Compute, Data, and other engineering platform teams to harden the shared cloud and access substrate that all of DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo build on, and deliver bespoke, in-house services where vendored platform controls don't fit.

• Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) practices for tier-0 security platforms with rigorous on-call rotations, clear escalation paths, and minimal downtime, since these systems are load-bearing for every other team's ability to ship and operate safely.

• Drive continuous hardening of AWS and GCP environments so insecure defaults are annihilated and prevented before they ever reach production.

• Influence and enable the secure and responsible adoption of AI tooling and agentic workflows from a platform hardening and access-control perspective.

We’re excited about you because…

• 12+ years of experience as a Security or Infrastructure Platform Engineer at an internet-scale organization, with 3+ years of demonstrated technical leadership leading teams building outcomes at global scale.

• Deep hands-on expertise hardening AWS and/or GCP at scale, including account structure, guardrails, workload and network posture, and golden image pipelines.

• Demonstrated technical leadership operating access and secrets infrastructure such as Teleport, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalent PAM/secrets-management platforms, including the on-call rigor required to run them as tier-0 services.

• Track record of building and running highly available, no-downtime platform services with mature on-call practices, incident response, and root cause analysis.

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Demonstrated technical leadership designing scalable security platform controls and processes that meet required regulatory requirements.

title: Data Engineer - Remote in Germany
description:
Location: Bremen / Remote in Germany · Full-time
About Synera

Synera builds the AI agent platform that lets hardware engineers connect their tools and automate their workflows. We sell to the world's leading engineering organizations and we run our own company the same way we build our product: automated, data-driven, and AI-first
About the role
We are building an internal superagent : an AI layer over all of Synera 's business data and tools that every employee can delegate work to. Its intelligence is only as good as the data underneath it, and that data foundation is yours to own, build, and shape.
That means the data warehouse, expanded from a GTM reporting store into Synera 's system of insight: GTM data, product telemetry, engineering work, support, finance, and everything in between. It means every connector into it and the interfaces that let agents query it. And it means working with every team to get their data out of heads and meetings and into a form an agent can use. An agent is only as intelligent as the data underneath it. We are looking for a builder.
Who you are:

• SQL is second nature; you have built ETL/data pipelines (Airflow or similar) and data models and are strong in data extraction and transformation.

• You have built the data layer behind LLM applications: retrieval, embeddings and vector search, context design, MCP and comparable tool interfaces. Hands-on evidence beats a course.

• You have integrated multiple systems: APIs, webhooks, auth models, rate limits and unannounced schema changes. You can debug a discrepancy across three tools until you find which definition was wrong, and you think about data access and privacy by default.

• An automator by instinct : scripts, APIs, workflow tools, and AI agents are how you scale yourself. You use LLMs as a daily working tool, not a novelty and the idea of building the data brain behind a company-wide AI agent excites you.

• You have built reporting and forecasting people actually use and know the difference between a dashboard and an answer.

• You work in English confidently; German is a plus. You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, sales reps, marketers, and executives alike.

• Ownership mentality: you document what you build, you notice what nobody asked about, and you would rather fix the system than the symptom

Why this role
You will own a whole machine, not a slice of one, with the mandate, the modern stack, and the AI tooling to build leverage instead of backlog. You will lay the data foundation for Synera 's superagent, and you report into Business Operations with a direct line to how the company is run.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the data warehouse (Timescale): Synera 's single source of truth for data, it's design and development to always be cutting edge.

• Extract data from our GTM and business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, product, finance, ...) into our data warehouse reliably, and structure & annotate it so it can be queried.

• Build and own data flows : ETL pipelines (Airflow/Timescale), data models, and the sync jobs that keep systems consistent.

• Turn data into foresight : build the reporting and forecasting layer (Power BI, Salesforce reports, forecast models) that leadership runs on and extrapolate from pipeline, funnel, and usage data to where the business is heading.

• Make the data agent-ready : model and expose it (warehouse models, APIs, MCP connectors, permissions, governance) so AI agents, and ultimately our superagent, can consume it.

• Build the retrieval layer for what is not in tables (documents, wiki content, tickets, meeting transcripts): chunking, embeddings, indexing. Agents working on outdated data give outdated and often wrong answers.

• Engineer, don't improvise : transformations are version-controlled, tested, and documented..

• Treat data quality as a product: monitoring, validation, and hygiene are built in,

• Team enablement: You partner with every team to get their data into the ware

description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry's issue platform processes billions of events every day to help millions of developers find and fix bugs. The hard part is deciding which events point to a problem, which belong together, and what a developer needs to know to investigate.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Issue Detection team, you'll design, build, and operate the systems that make those decisions. You'll work on real-time processing pipelines, monitors, and analysis systems that detect problems and turn them into issues. The work combines distributed systems with product engineering. Choices about detection accuracy and processing latency affect which problems developers see and how soon they can act.

You'll help shape how developers monitor their applications and how Sentry groups related events into issues. You'll also build the context developers and AI agents need to investigate what went wrong. Keeping these systems reliable and fast as Sentry grows is part of the job, alongside making the issues they produce more useful.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Build and scale features on a product surface handling billions of events daily, where both query latency and correctness are immediately visible to users.

- Own the design and delivery of substantial projects end to end, scoping alongside product and design, making the technical calls within your scope, shipping, and instrumenting what you ship so the team can measure it.

- You will contribute to meaningful technical product decisions: grouping quality, search performance, migrations and backfills against enormous datasets, and making the surface work well for both humans and agents.

- Champion product quality and user experience. Build features that don't just work-they delight. You understand that milliseconds matter in the developer experience. You sweat the details of interfaces, error messages, loading states, and edge cases. You instrument everything so the team can measure and improve.

- Mentor and elevate others. You've helped engineers grow their skills. You celebrate wins and learn from failures alongside your teammates.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- Are a distributed systems engineer who understands the realities of high-scale architectures. You know about eventual consistency, partitioning strategies, caching layers, and query optimization. You've debugged enough systems at scale that you now know to design for failure and build systems that degrade gracefully.

- Are product-minded and understand that great engineering serves users. You collaborate effectively with Product and Design, offering technical perspectives that shape better products. You can explain technical constraints in user-centric terms. You get excited about making developers' lives better, not just solving technical puzzles.

- Have strong full-stack instincts. While this role is backend-heavy, you understand the entire system from data ingestion to what renders in the browser. You know enough about frontend performance, API design, and user experience to make good architectural decisions that consider the whole picture.

- Include and uplift others. You've helped engineers grow their skills in systems design, coding practices, and product thinking. You're generous with knowledge and patient in explaining complex concepts. You celebrate wins and learn from failures alongside your teammates.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of full-stack software engineering experience, ideally Python and TypeScript

- Strong domain modeling skills, with working experience in distributed systems, data stores, and message queues

- Excellent written and verbal communication s

We are on a journey to build a unified, world class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer driven innovation to power our growth and strategic initiatives.

As a Product Manager, Unified Platform (Health & Benefits), you will serve as the architectural connective tissue across our Health & Benefits ecosystem. You will own the execution and delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating across the business on the product roadmap with an emphasis on creating a simple, proactive and personalized experience.

About the team:
We are the architects of Wex’s forthcoming unified experience for all Health and Benefits clients. Our mission is to take the complex, siloed worlds of Benefits Administration, Consumer Directed Health (CDH), and Cobra Direct Bill (CDB), and weave them into a single, cohesive ecosystem. We are moving away from fragmented legacy systems toward a modern API-first and Micro-Frontend (MFE) architecture. We operate in a new and at times ambiguous space, tasked with defining the common data standards and seamless workflows that allow our products to feel like one experience, rather than a collection of separate tools.

• Bridge Stakeholder Gaps: Act as the primary link between business leaders, UX, and engineering to ensure everyone is aligned on the unified vision and the trade-offs required to get there.

• Leverage AI for Efficiency: Use AI tools to accelerate the discovery process, from drafting complex technical requirements, to identifying patterns in large datasets, to building prototypes of new features.

• Identify Common Denominators: Look across different product tribes to find where we are duplicating effort and lead the charge in consolidating those into shared, scalable services.

title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Go
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Go, you will be the first dedicated security engineer inside our logistics business - and the person who makes Vinted Go's security posture match its growth. Vinted Go is a rare security problem in the best sense: a European-scale logistics network where software, physical infrastructure, and dozens of external partners meet. Its attack surface spans shipping services and carrier APIs, a locker and PUDO network in public space, sorting facilities with real operational technology, driver and warehouse applications, and hardware and engineering partners.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in Vinted Go engineering, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services, while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Go's local execution is what you will build - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate. You will work directly with Vinted Go's engineering leadership and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace and Vinted Pay.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself, and as the function matures you will stand up and functionally lead a Vinted Go Security Ops capability.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the Vinted Go security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - with the explicit goal of keeping Vinted Go's resilience to external attack ahead of its growth and at the standard Vinted holds itself to.

• Secure a physical-digital surface few companies have: carrier integrations, locker and PUDO hardware, sorting-facility operational technology (conveyors, robotics, cameras), driver and warehouse applications, and electronics verification related software and hardware.

• Stand up Vinted Go's Security Ops capability - detection, response, and vulnerability management for Vinted Go-specific systems - building on central platforms rather than duplicating them.

• Embed secure development into Vinted Go engineering, including external engineering partners, so security lands at design time rather than after deployment.

• Own third-party security across the network: 40+ carriers, hardware vendors, and outsourced engineering - set the requirements, verify them, and manage the residual risk

title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.
Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou
combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers.
Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du
projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/

MISSIONS
Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes :

• Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de

fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste.
2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes
que les modèles acquièrent.
3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet.

ACTIVITÉS :

• Critères de diversité dans les représentations :

• Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de
fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables.
• Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus
ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus
compacte que la seule importance individuelle.
• Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les
profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues.
2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes :
• Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des
modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement.
• Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les
mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation.
• Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en
particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.
3. Production scientifique et vie du projet :
• Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales.
• Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats.

Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :
🎓 Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans

title: Staff Frontend Engineer - Mapping & Spatial Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are looking for a founding Staff Engineer to lead the technical architecture of our next-generation Spatial Platform. For the past decade, floor plans have been static images; we are rebuilding that foundation from the ground up as a high-performance, interactive, and collaborative 3D engine.

This is a greenfield role for a builder who wants to own a core pillar of Verkada’s infrastructure before we hit the public markets. You won't just build features-you will architect a platform that supports 8+ product lines, solving the "hard math" of geospatial projections and the "hard graphics" of rendering thousands of interactive assets at a buttery-smooth 60 FPS.

What You'll Do

• Build the Rendering Platform: Design a high-performance rendering architecture that supports both an interactive viewer for high-density geospatial visualization and a precision editing surface for real-time vertex manipulation.

• Set the UX Bar: Partner with Design to define the interaction model for spatial editing - easing curves, snapping behavior, cursor states, loading transitions - and hold the line on pixel-level polish across the platform.

• Optimize for Latency: Solve the "500-element wall" with partial GPU buffer updates and custom shaders, ensuring sub-millisecond input latency during real-time vertex manipulation.

• Spatial Intelligence: Develop power-user tools like real-time 3D line-of-sight analysis, signal strength heatmaps, and AI-driven hardware placement suggestions.

• Build the Sync Engine: Own the client-side CRDT architecture (Yjs/Automerge-class) powering offline-first, multi-user editing - document model, local persistence, presence, and conflict resolution.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience building complex, customer-facing web applications or high-performance graphics engines.

• Mastery of Web Technologies: JavaScript fundamentals (scoping, closures, contexts, prototypes, classes, etc.) and React expertise (common state and data libraries like React Query, Zustand, etc.)

• CS Fundamentals: A degree in Computer Science or a related field, with strong intuition for data structures, memory management, and linear algebra.

• Eye for Detail: Pixel-perfect execution - you notice the half-pixel misalignment, the 16ms jank, the easing curve that feels "off." You hold a high bar for visual polish and won't ship until interactions feel  right.

• Product Grit: Ability to bridge the gap between CAD-level precision and consumer-grade UX, partnering closely with Design to turn rough specs into delightful, production-grade experiences.

• Mathematical Precision: Understanding of coordinate system conversions, geospatial projections, and 3D geometry.

Nice to Haves

• Graphics Stack: Experience with Deck.gl, MapLibre, Three.js, or raw WebGL/WebGPU.

• Collaborative Systems: Experien

title: Chef de projet – Mise à jour SAP S/4HANA
description:
Lieu : Montréal - télétravail possible depuis le Québec ou l’Ontario
Durée : Jusqu’au 31 janvier 2027, renouvelable

Heures : 35 h/semaine

Langue : Anglais requis - profil bilingue accepté

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un Chef de projet SAP S/4HANA senior pour piloter un projet de mise à niveau de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA vers une version plus récente. La personne sera responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de l’exécution complète de l’upgrade, de la préparation initiale jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation post-déploiement.

Le mandat évolue dans une grande organisation de plus de 10 000 employés, au sein d’un environnement complexe et fortement réglementé. Le Chef de projet travaillera avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes, notamment SAP, BASIS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, équipes d’affaires, partenaires et fournisseurs.

Exigences principales

• 10+ années d’expérience en gestion de projets SAP.

• Expérience concrète dans la gestion de mises à niveau SAP S/4HANA, idéalement d’une version 2020/2021 vers 2023 ou plus récente.

• Excellente maîtrise de la méthodologie SAP Activate.

• Expérience importante dans les domaines Supply Chain et Manufacturing.

• Expérience dans une organisation de plus de 10 000 employés.

• Expérience de projets SAP globaux impliquant plusieurs équipes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes.

• Expérience en environnement hautement réglementé.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires simultanément.

• Expérience importante dans la planification et le pilotage des tests, cutover et mises en production.

• Excellente maîtrise de la gouvernance de projet, notamment échéanciers, budgets, jalons, dépendances et registres RAID.

• Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes techniques, les responsables d’affaires et la haute direction.

Atouts

Une expérience en custom code remediation lors d’un upgrade S/4HANA est particulièrement pertinente. Une bonne compréhension de SAP BASIS et de l’architecture SAP, ainsi qu’une expérience de tests à grande échelle et de périodes d’hypercare/stabilisation post-go-live, constituent également des atouts.

Les certifications PMP, PRINCE2 ou SAP sont appréciées.

Responsabilités principales

Le Chef de projet prendra en charge le plan détaillé de la mise à niveau SAP, incluant les échéanciers, ressources, jalons, risques, enjeux et dépendances. Il pilotera les différentes phases du projet selon SAP Activate, notamment la préparation, le Sandbox, le développement, l’assurance qualité, les tests et la mise en production.

Il coordonnera les campagnes de tests intégrés, de régression et de performance, ainsi que la stratégie et l’exécution du cutover. Il sera également responsable de la coordination entre les équipes SAP/BASIS, les responsables des processus d’affaires, les équipes Supply Chain et Manufacturing ainsi que les différents fournisseurs.

La personne assurera la gouvernance du projet, le contrôle des changements, le suivi des risques et la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction. Elle contribuera également à la gestion du changement, à la formation, à la documentation et à la période de stabilisation suivant la mise en production.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

You will ship LLM-powered product features end-to-end. That means designing retrieval and tool-calling flows, writing the services that run them, building evals and guardrails, and watching cost, latency, and quality in production. You’ll partner with the ML/infra teammates on embeddings, indexing, and model hosting, and with the product teammates on user experience and outcomes. We move fast, and we care about reliability in a safety-critical domain.

This role is for engineers who set technical direction across services and teams (8+ years experience, with a track record of owning systems or defining standards others build against). You'll lead design for ambiguous, cross-team problems like provider routing or shared retrieval infra.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build user-facing LLM features

- Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation and tool-calling flows using frameworks like LangChain or equivalent primitives, where simpler is better.

- Deliver robust JSON and schema-bound outputs with validation, retries, and fallbacks.

- Add function calling to integrate with internal tools, search, routing, and data services.

Own the service layer
